tape_read.note: Robust reference $164.50, +9.93% vs the $149.64 close, against a frozen release read of +12% and a 13.5% implied move: a slight undershoot of ~2 points, within noise, so read as fair. After hours reached +20.2% ($179.88) and the pre-market high was $179.50 with a low of $162.00, so the move ran up overnight and has sagged by half. Pre-market active (37 prints, 9 in the last 30 min, last 09:15, not stale). QQQ -1.0%, IWM -0.9% in the pre-market. Position already +10.8% from the $148.52 entry.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was an AMD-driven FQ1/FY27 guide on a de-rated stock with consignment optics as the offset; the FY27 guide came in well above the $16bn target and the quarter beat by ~11% on revenue. The FQ1 margin step-down is the offset the panel named.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market, so the open should hold most of the +9.9%. An amc print with a night to read, a ~10% gap, a pre-market that has already sagged from +20% and a soft Nasdaq tape all lean toward some give-back by 10:00; the release read only slightly above the pre-market does not argue for waiting.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn sterk en bevestigen de stelling (omzet en winst ruim boven verwachting, jaarprognose fors hoger), maar de voorbeurskoers van ongeveer +10% houdt dat al grotendeels in. Na de nabeurs (+20%) is de koers al gehalveerd en de Nasdaq staat lager, dus wachten na de opening voegt eerder risico toe dan rendement. Volg de standaardregel: verkopen bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 weer duidelijk richting $175 klimt op actieve handel, of er komen meerdere koersdoelverhogingen binnen, dan is vasthouden tot 10:00 of de slotkoers te verdedigen.
